[[Image:Manor Mistmantle.jpg|thumb|300px|Manor Mistmantle]]
'''Manor Mistmantle''' is the family stead of the Mistmantle family. It is located in northeastern [[Duskwood]], north of [[Darkshire]] and west of [[Beggar's Haunt]]. The lone survivor of the Mistmantle legacy is [[Stalvan Mistmantle]], a former school teacher and personal tutor who is now an agent of the [[undead]]. The manor grounds are rotten and overrun by Stalvan's [[ghoul]]ish minions. The only sign of life on the property is a single flower in the garden, known as the [[Tear of Tilloa]].
